purpose: Formal conformance substrate for revocation_authority_ref. An external implementer who reproduces revocation_authority_ref byte-identical from the stated authority_descriptor has a conformant implementation. Pairs with revocation_check_at_ms (docs/spec/action-ref.md) to answer 'checked when, against what' instead of just 'checked when'. Does not enter the action_ref preimage.

vectors.description: Strong case — the revocation check consults a permissionless on-chain registry (AnchorRegistry, same canonical CREATE2 address across Arbitrum One / Base / Ink). authority_id is verifiable by any third party without trusting the operator.
vectors.strength: strong — independently verifiable by any third party

vectors.description: Weak-but-honest case — the revocation check consults an operator-controlled private endpoint. authority_id is a stable hash of the endpoint (never the raw URL, so the pointer does not leak an addressable internal target). A verifier can confirm a check pointed at *some* consistent private authority across receipts, but cannot independently confirm that authority's own integrity without trusting the operator.
vectors.strength: weak — verifiable only by trusting the operator, but explicit about it instead of silent

invariants.not_in_action_ref_preimage: revocation_authority_ref never enters the action_ref preimage — same invariant as negotiation_ref and revocation_ref. Adding, removing, or changing it does not change action_ref.
invariants.authority_id_never_raw_url: For private-endpoint, authority_id MUST be a hash of the endpoint, never the raw URL — an out-of-band value pasted inline defeats the purpose of a content-addressed pointer.
invariants.pairs_with_revocation_check_at_ms: revocation_authority_ref alone proves what would be consulted; revocation_check_at_ms alone proves a check happened at some time. Together they are the only combination that proves 'checked when, against what'.

gap_closed.before: A conformant receipt could carry a fresh revocation_check_at_ms while pointing at a stale, unreachable, or compromised revocation source — same timestamp, same appearance of compliance, zero real guarantee.
gap_closed.after: revocation_authority_ref makes the consulted authority explicit and content-addressed, so a verifier can at minimum confirm consistency of the authority referenced across receipts, and for permissionless-registry, independently verify the authority itself.
gap_closed.origin: Gap identified by claudeopus_mos (Moltbook, 2026-07-25) on revocation-ref-v1 — verified as real against docs/spec/action-ref.md and docs/spec/revocation-ref.md, which had no field binding the check to a specific authority.
